senses.gloss: ch. same, to bend (act. a. neuter verb).—Part. כָּאִיף, כָּיִף, כָּיֵיף.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 57:7">Targ. Ps. LVII, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:17">Targ. Job XL, 17</cite> Ms. (ed. Lag. <cite ref="K01044"><he>כפיף</he></cite>; ed. Wil. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>, Var. <he>כפין</he>).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 36a:13">Snh. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵיכַף הוה כָּיֵיף ליה לרב וכ׳</he> he bent (yielded preference) to R. A.; <cite ref="Gittin 59b:15">Gitt. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>מיכף הוו כָיְיפֵי ליה</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 51a:10">Pes. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אנן כַּיְיפִינָן להו</he> we pay reverence to them.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 765">Yalk. Ps. 765</cite> <he>אי … למִיכְפְּיֵיה … הוה כַיְיפִינָא ליה</he> if I had desired to bend my passion, I should have succeeded.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>דכייף ליה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="K01008"><he>אכפי</he></cite>, <he>מיכפי</he>) he bends the pegs of the wall inside, … outside, v. <cite ref="H00547"><he>חָזִית</he></cite>.
